Senses.Explanation: Ten thousand miles without an inch of grass. Dongshan Liangjie, pressed by Huayan's honest admitting that he has no reasoning-path, rules that just so he must go to the grassless ten thousand miles — and when Huayan asks whether he may go there, seals it: just so, go; Yuanwu Keqin closes his retreat-dissolving verse on it — ninety days' work complete, no need to test the wax man, and yet though the ten thousand miles hold no inch of grass, the bag's mouth opens today; Wuzhun Shifan lists the ancients' moves at the retreat's end and tears them all off at once — Cuiyan's talking east and west, Yangshan's millet fields, Wenyuan's fall into donkey dung, Dongshan's trailing his heel toward the grassless ten thousand miles; Wansong Xingxiu opens his own hall instruction by pairing it — the grassless ten thousand miles: clean ground deludes people; eight directions without a wisp of cloud: clear sky cheats you. Gulin Qingmao, having opened the ancients' sky-road and named it the great pure extinction, licenses the assembly to go east or west at tomorrow's Pravarana — only not to the grassless ten thousand miles; Luyan He, after raising Dongshan's charge, Shishuang's grass-at-the-door and Ming'an's grass-even-inside, rules the formula only says half — out the door or in, they are all men in the grass — and demands the turning-around phrase; Liaozong Chaojian judges the three old men one nostril breathing, themselves standing in the grass, then answers his own question — through the bramble thicket, not one leaf wet; and Yushan Shangsi warns that to go to the grassless ten thousand miles leaves dead men beyond count on flat ground, while to hide where grass begins at the door takes a good hand threading the brambles — the true performer poles open a line wherever he lands.
